acceptance_criteria: profile intervals exactly match durable attempt start/completion timestamps
trajectory file hashes are preserved in each profile
old defect is not redefined away
corrected live interval has zero observable wait-induced model activations
one durable terminal-event activation remains separately visible
provider-level turn evidence remains explicitly unknown

may: read the two named Codex trajectory JSONL files
import those profiles through the deterministic telemetry command
validate exact expected counts and trajectory hashes
may_not: modify source, tests, docs, policy, objective history, supervisor identity, prior events, prior evidence, tasks, attempts, claims, or sibling repositories
invoke any AI provider or review
claim provider-measured turns, tokens, or cost
deploy, merge, push, install server-wide, or initialize another repository

deterministic_command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p .opsle/evidence/activation-profiles
node tools/profile-codex-activations.mjs --trajectory /home/deploy/.codex/sessions/2026/08/31/rollout-2026-08-31T20-41-48-01a0598e-8965-76f2-beef-5282cda666cc.jsonl --start 2026-08-31T20:52:24.491Z --end 2026-08-31T21:03:34.571Z --task task-fix-derived-next-action-invariant --attempt task-fix-derived-next-action-invariant-attempt-001 > .opsle/evidence/activation-profiles/prior-defective.json
node tools/profile-codex-activations.mjs --trajectory /home/deploy/.codex/sessions/2026/08/31/rollout-2026-08-31T21-19-41-01a059b1-3963-7162-9d07-a72602222ae0.jsonl --start 2026-08-31T22:02:56.621Z --end 2026-08-31T22:08:03.111Z --task task-live-wakeup-invariant-audit --attempt task-live-wakeup-invariant-audit-attempt-001 > .opsle/evidence/activation-profiles/corrected-live.json
jq -e '.counts.wait_induced_automatic == 23 and .counts.human == 0 and .provider_model_turns == null' .opsle/evidence/activation-profiles/prior-defective.json >/dev/null
jq -e '.counts.wait_induced_automatic == 0 and .counts.human == 0 and .provider_model_turns == null' .opsle/evidence/activation-profiles/corrected-live.json >/dev/null
./bin/opsle.js telemetry import-activation-profile --input .opsle/evidence/activation-profiles/prior-defective.json
./bin/opsle.js telemetry import-activation-profile --input .opsle/evidence/activation-profiles/corrected-live.json

operator_policy_constraints: model polling and wait-induced automatic reasoning prohibited
